## You’ve got questions. We’ve got answers.

### [How is SEOwind different from other AI tools?](https://seowind.io/update-content/\#)

We don’t just rewrite content. SEOwind uses AI agents that analyze your brand voice, your current content, and what’s ranking – then rebuild content with context, strategy, and performance in mind.

### [Will the content still sound like us?](https://seowind.io/update-content/\#)

Yes. You can define your voice, add insights, and guide the tone. Our agents work around your expertise – not over it.

### [How long does it take to update an article?](https://seowind.io/update-content/\#)

From input to review-ready draft: usually under 10 minutes. You save hours without sacrificing quality or control.

### [What kind of results can I expect?](https://seowind.io/update-content/\#)

Most users see better rankings, more traffic, and stronger engagement within a few weeks, especially on pages that were previously underperforming or hit by Google updates.

### [Is SEOwind's Content Update better than manual rewrites?](https://seowind.io/update-content/\#)

SEOwind is faster, more comprehensive, and data-driven, often outperforming manual updates in SEO results.

### [Do I need SEO expertise to use it?](https://seowind.io/update-content/\#)

Not at all. SEOwind is built for marketers, not just SEOs. You don’t need to know technical SEO. We handle that behind the scenes.
